findings.description: Critical: packages/gen-eval/tests/test_integration_scenarios.py:45 and packages/gen-eval/tests/test_integration_orchestrator.py:34 still resolve scenario roots to the missing repo-root path evaluation/gen_eval/scenarios. Ran `cd packages/gen-eval && uv run pytest tests/test_integration_scenarios.py tests/test_integration_orchestrator.py -q --tb=line` → 7 failures with `Scenario directory not found: .../evaluation/gen_eval/scenarios/<category>` and `report.total_scenarios == 0`. CI excludes them (`not e2e and not integration`), but package `make test` is `pytest -m "not slow"` which includes them (`7 failed` under `not slow and integration`).

Nit: delta spec Descriptor Reclamation (spec.md:215-227) and ToolDescriptor docstring (descriptor.py:413) still require a CONTRACT_VERSION increment for export reclamation. Empirically CONTRACT_VERSION stays "2" (constant, VERSION file, all three schemas); tasks.md:532-539 correctly forbids the bump; schema changes are additive only.

Optional: load_descriptor deprecation only checks `if not data.get("contract")`. A ToolDescriptor YAML with `contract: missing-contract.yaml` (file absent), hand-authored `--a`, loaded with 0 DeprecationWarnings; interfaces still `['cli:--a']`. Any non-empty contract string silences the D6 warning while the surface stays hand-typed.

Nit: check_coverage_completeness.py docstring still says dogfood exercises 5 of 17 flags. After `make dogfood`, report shows 10/17 (58.8%) with 7 exclusions — Makefile comment is correct, script docstring is stale.
Nit: evaluation/README.md layout/table omit Phase 5 flag-surface.yaml and coverage-exclusions.yaml that make dogfood actually uses.
Nit: check_coverage_completeness.py catches FileNotFoundError/ValueError but not YAML ParserError; invalid exclusions YAML exits 1 with a raw traceback instead of `_fail(...)`.
FYI: resolve_path_item drops sibling parameters on a path item that uses $ref; only parameters on the resolved path item merge. OAS 3.1 leaves ref+sibling field conflicts undefined.
